sentences.text:
Md Siraj Ali Mondal & Anr vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on
2 December, 2025
02.12.2025
Court No.42
Item No.74
Sudipta
 Crr 5014 of 2025

Md Siraj Ali Mondal & Anr.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.

1 . 
Present petition has been filed for quashing of the proceedings being Kashipur Police Station Case No. 264 dated 08.09.2020 under Sections 498A / 406 / 34 of the IPC.
2. Learned counsel submits that chargesheet has already been filed.
It has been further submitted that the allegations against the petitioners are general, vague and omnibus in nature.
3. Issue notice to the State of West Bengal through the office of the Public Prosecutor.
Opposite party no.2 be also served.
5. Let the matter appear in the Combined Monthly List of March, 2026.

(Dinesh Kumar Sharma, J.)
